'''Halidrell Setsyn''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|female]] who served as one of [[Darth Baras]]' operatives during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]].

==Biography==
Over the [[Standard year/Legends|years]], Setsyn ran Baras' [[Slavery/Legends|slaving]] operation on [[Nar Shaddaa/Legends|Nar Shaddaa]]. She came into the [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord's]] service unexpectedly after taking over from his previous operative–she tricked the slaver out of a large number of [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]] and some of his stock, not knowing who he worked for. Before Setsyn could escape the planet, Baras contacted her and offered the position that had suddenly opened up.<ref name="Codex">{{TORcite|type=codex|Halidrell Setsyn (Warrior)}}''</ref>

In [[3643 BBY]], Setsyn assisted [[Empire's Wrath|Baras' apprentice]] in their plan to eliminate [[Dellocon]], one of Baras' former secret agents, and [[Rathari]], a rival Sith Lord who offered him protection.<ref>{{TORcite|type=class|Sith Warrior|Seek Your Contact|the Sith Warrior's personal ship}}''</ref> Under her guidance, Baras' apprentice thwarted Rathari's deal with the [[Hutt Cartel/Legends|Hutt Cartel]], which also resulted in the death of the his [[Sith apprentice/Legends|apprentice]] [[Girik]],<ref>{{TORcite|type=class|Sith Warrior|Disrupt Negotiations|Nar Shaddaa}}''</ref> and later destroyed the Sith Lord's forces sieging [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] outpost Shylon, at Nar Shaddaa's Upper Industrial Sector.<ref>{{TORcite|type=class|Sith Warrior|An Army of One|Nar Shaddaa}}''</ref> Unfortunately for Setsyn, Rathari was able to track down and assault her base, [[Death/Legends|killing]] her after a brief confrontation

Later, Baras expressed his condolences for her loss and admitted to having a soft spot for her.<ref>{{TORcite|type=class|Sith Warrior|Distress Call|Nar Shaddaa}}''</ref>

==Personality and traits==
A witty flirt and able liar, she was able to talk her way both into and out of trouble. She had a tendency to overreach but had become proficient at escaping death as a result.<ref name="Codex" />

==Behind the scenes==
Halidrell Setsyn is the NPC responsible for starting Nar Shaddaa's first missions within the Sith Warrior storyline, playable in ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''. Male Sith Warriors can flirt with her.
